arguments.query: SELECT region_code,count(*) FROM customers GROUP BY 1
SELECT tier,count(*) FROM customers GROUP BY 1
SELECT status,count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY 1
SELECT payment_status,count(*) FROM payments GROUP BY 1
SELECT channel,count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY 1

SELECT o.status, count(*), sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payments p WHERE p.order_id=o.order_id AND payment_status='ok')) paid, sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id=o.order_id)) shipped, sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id=o.order_id AND delivered_ts IS NOT NULL)) deliv, sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM refunds r WHERE r.order_id=o.order_id)) refd FROM orders o GROUP BY 1
SELECT count(*), count(distinct order_id) FROM payments
SELECT o.status, count(*) FROM orders o JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY 1
SELECT o.status, count(distinct o.order_id) FROM orders o JOIN payments s ON s.order_id=o.order_id WHERE s.payment_status='ok' GROUP BY 1
SELECT o.status, count(distinct o.order_id) FROM orders o JOIN refunds s ON s.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY 1
SELECT o.status, count(distinct o.order_id) FROM orders o JOIN order_items s ON s.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY 1

SELECT sum(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents)/100.0 FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE c.region_code='TW-N' AND c.tier='G' AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND o.order_ts>='2025-01-01' AND o.order_ts<'2026-01-01'

SELECT sum(r.refund_amount_twd) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id JOIN refunds r ON r.order_id=o.order_id WHERE c.region_code='TW-N' AND c.tier='G' AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND o.order_ts>='2025-01-01' AND o.order_ts<'2026-01-01'

SELECT sum(p.amount_twd) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id WHERE c.region_code='TW-N' AND c.tier='G' AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND p.payment_status='ok' AND o.order_ts>='2025-01-01' AND o.order_ts<'2026-01-01'
